instruction: A professional office photograph in a medium shot captures a bright office setting with a whiteboard on the left and a large window in the background. On the left, the man in the beige t-shirt (R2) wearing glasses stands and leans forward across a wooden desk. On the right, the man in the blue patterned blazer (R1) stands and leans forward to meet him. The two men shake hands firmly with their right hands over the desk, which holds a laptop and documents. Both maintain neutral, professional expressions. The scene is illuminated by bright, natural daylight streaming from the window, creating a clean and airy atmosphere with soft shadows.
